refinement.rule: links without a place on the 2.0 mm grid are searched again in their order, every placed link fixed, same rules, sizes, radius and cost; a place found is fixed before the next link; the tail-extension step stays 2.0 mm

improvement.rule: for a link still without a place: among its rules-legal places (cheapest first), one that exactly one placed link blocks; that link is searched again on the 0.5 mm grid with the blocked link placed there and every other link fixed, and is moved when its new cost is at most its recorded cost plus the allowance; each blocking link is tried once per blocked link and round
